## With X = 1


```{r, fig.height=12,fig.width=8}

fit = function(){
  
  qq = rnorm(1,1,1)
  
  df = simulate_data_mcmc_x1(n = 300)
# 
#   mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Simulations","old.stan"))
#   
#   datastan = list(a = df$a_gauss,
#                   ACC = df$ACC,
#                   C = df$C,
#                   # rts = df$rts,
#                   N = nrow(df),
#                   XD = df$X * df$D,
#                   X = df$X)
#   
#   
#   fit = mod$sample(data = datastan,
#                    iter_warmup = 500,
#                    refresh = 0,
#                    iter_sampling = 500,
#              parallel_chains = 4)
#   
#   div = data.frame(fit$diagnostic_summary())%>% mutate(sim = qq,
#                                                         time = fit$time()$total)
#   
#   estimated = fit$summary("gm") %>% mutate(variable = c("alpha","beta","confprec","metauncor","metauninc","metabias"
#                                             )) %>% mutate(div = max(div$num_divergent))
#   
#   loo = fit$loo()
#   
#   pareto_o7 = sum(loo$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7)
  
  
  modnew = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Simulations","Heurestic_X1.stan"))

  datastan = list(a = df$a_gauss,
                ACC = df$ACC,
                C = df$C,
                N = nrow(df),
                XD = df$X * df$D,
                X = df$X)

    

  fita = modnew$sample(data = datastan,
                   iter_warmup = 500,
                   refresh = 0,
                   iter_sampling = 500,
             parallel_chains = 4)
  
  diva = data.frame(fita$diagnostic_summary())%>% mutate(sim = qq,
                                                        time = fita$time()$total)
  
  estimateda = fita$summary("gm") %>% mutate(variable = c("beta","sigma_e","sigma_k","sigma_m","confprec"
                                            )) %>% mutate(div = max(diva$num_divergent))
  
  # looa = fita$loo()
  # 
  # pareto_o7a = sum(looa$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7)
  # 
  # loo_comparison = data.frame(loo::loo_compare(list(old = loo, action = looa))) %>% 
  #   rownames_to_column("model") %>% 
  #   arrange(model) %>% 
  #   mutate(pareto_k = c(pareto_o7a,pareto_o7))
  # 
  # additional = fita$summary(c("sigma1","sigma2"))%>% 
  #   mutate(div = max(diva$num_divergent))
  
  
  simulated = data.frame(c0 = unique(df$c0),
                         c1 = unique(df$c1),
                         sigma_k = unique(df$sigma_k),
                         sigma_e =unique(df$sigma_e),
                         sigma_m =unique(df$sigma_m),
                         bias = unique(df$bias),
                         conf_prec =unique(df$conf_prec)) %>% mutate(sim_n = qq)
  
  data = df %>% mutate(conf_bin = cut(C,4),
                      stimulus  = as.factor(D),
                      participant = 1,
                      rating = as.numeric(as.factor(conf_bin)),
                      correct = ACC) %>% drop_na()


  
  mratio = fitMetaDprime(data)
  
    
  result = list(simulated = simulated %>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                estimateda = estimateda%>% mutate(sim_n = qq, model = "action"),
                data = df%>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                diva = diva,
                mratio = mratio %>% mutate(sim_n = qq))
  
  return(result)
}

qq = fit()

plan(multisession, workers = 10)

safe_function <- possibly(fit, otherwise = "Error")

# Run 20 times in parallel
results_list <- future_map(1:1000, ~ safe_function(), .progress = T)

saveRDS(results_list,here::here("Simulations","Heurestic","Saved models","1000sim_300trials_finalHeu_X1.RData"))

results_list = results_list[-which(results_list == "Error")]
```


## Plotting

```{r}
results_list = readRDS("~/RDM-metacognition/Simulations/Heurestic/Saved models/1000sim_300trials_finalHeu_X1.RData")

inner_join(
  map_dfr(results_list,1), 
  map_dfr(results_list,2) %>% 
    filter(rhat < 1.03 & ess_bulk > 400, ess_tail > 400) %>% 
    select(mean,variable,sim_n,div) %>% 
    pivot_wider(names_from = "variable",values_from = c("mean")) %>% 
    unnest() %>% drop_na() %>% rename_with(~ paste0("esti_", .x)) %>% 
    mutate(sim_n = esti_sim_n)
) %>% 
    # filter(div == 0 & 1/sqrt(sigma_k^2+sigma_e^2) < 20) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = esti_sigma_e, y = sigma_e))+geom_point(alpha = 0.1)+geom_abline()+
  ggtitle("action model")
```

```{r}
  map_dfr(results_list,1),
  map_dfr(results_list,5) 
) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1/sqrt(exp(sigma_m)^2+exp(sigma_e)^2 + exp(sigma_k)^2), y = metaD))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_abline()


inner_join(
  map_dfr(results_list,1),
  map_dfr(results_list,5) 
) %>% 
  filter(Ratio < 3 & Ratio > 0.1) %>%
  filter((sigma_e & sigma_k & sigma_m > -5) & sigma_e & sigma_k & sigma_m < 0) %>%
  mutate(xs = cut((1/sqrt(exp(sigma_m)^2+exp(sigma_e)^2 + exp(sigma_k)^2)) / (1/sqrt(exp(sigma_e) ^2 +exp(sigma_k)^2)),10)) %>% 
  group_by(xs) %>% 
  summarize(mean = mean(Ratio),
            lower = HDInterval::hdi(Ratio,0.95)[1],
            upper = HDInterval::hdi(Ratio,0.95)[2]) %>% 
  mutate(xs = as.numeric(xs)/10) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = xs, y = mean))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = lower,ymax = upper))+
  geom_abline()


vv = inner_join(
  map_dfr(results_list,1),
  map_dfr(results_list,5) 
) 

cor.test(1/sqrt(exp(vv$sigma_m)^2+exp(vv$sigma_e)^2), vv$metaD)


cor.test(1/sqrt(exp(vv$sigma_e)), vv$dprime)

cor.test(1/sqrt(exp(vv$sigma_m)^2+exp(vv$sigma_e)^2 + exp(vv$sigma_k)^2) / (1/sqrt(exp(vv$sigma_e)^2 +exp(vv$sigma_k)^2)), vv$Ratio)
```

```{r, fig.height=12,fig.width=8}

fit = function(){
  
  qq = rnorm(1,1,1)
  
  df = simulate_data_mcmc(n = 300)
# 
#   mod = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Simulations","old.stan"))
#   
#   datastan = list(a = df$a_gauss,
#                   ACC = df$ACC,
#                   C = df$C,
#                   # rts = df$rts,
#                   N = nrow(df),
#                   XD = df$X * df$D,
#                   X = df$X)
#   
#   
#   fit = mod$sample(data = datastan,
#                    iter_warmup = 500,
#                    refresh = 0,
#                    iter_sampling = 500,
#              parallel_chains = 4)
#   
#   div = data.frame(fit$diagnostic_summary())%>% mutate(sim = qq,
#                                                         time = fit$time()$total)
#   
#   estimated = fit$summary("gm") %>% mutate(variable = c("alpha","beta","confprec","metauncor","metauninc","metabias"
#                                             )) %>% mutate(div = max(div$num_divergent))
#   
#   loo = fit$loo()
#   
#   pareto_o7 = sum(loo$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7)
  
  
  modnew = cmdstanr::cmdstan_model(here::here("Stanmodels","Heurestic models","Simulations","Heurestic.stan"))

  datastan = list(a = df$a_gauss,
                ACC = df$ACC,
                C = df$C,
                N = nrow(df),
                XD = df$X * df$D,
                X = df$X)

    

  fita = modnew$sample(data = datastan,
                   iter_warmup = 500,
                   refresh = 0,
                   iter_sampling = 500,
             parallel_chains = 4)
  
  diva = data.frame(fita$diagnostic_summary())%>% mutate(sim = qq,
                                                        time = fita$time()$total)
  
  estimateda = fita$summary("gm") %>% mutate(variable = c("beta","sigma_e","sigma_k","sigma_m","confprec"
                                            )) %>% mutate(div = max(diva$num_divergent))
  
  # looa = fita$loo()
  # 
  # pareto_o7a = sum(looa$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7)
  # 
  # loo_comparison = data.frame(loo::loo_compare(list(old = loo, action = looa))) %>% 
  #   rownames_to_column("model") %>% 
  #   arrange(model) %>% 
  #   mutate(pareto_k = c(pareto_o7a,pareto_o7))
  # 
  # additional = fita$summary(c("sigma1","sigma2"))%>% 
  #   mutate(div = max(diva$num_divergent))
  
  
  simulated = data.frame(c0 = unique(df$c0),
                         c1 = unique(df$c1),
                         sigma_k = unique(df$sigma_k),
                         sigma_e =unique(df$sigma_e),
                         sigma_m =unique(df$sigma_m),
                         bias = unique(df$bias),
                         conf_prec =unique(df$conf_prec)) %>% mutate(sim_n = qq)
  
  data = df %>% mutate(conf_bin = cut(C,4),
                      stimulus  = as.factor(D),
                      participant = 1,
                      rating = as.numeric(as.factor(conf_bin)),
                      correct = ACC) %>% drop_na()


  
  mratio = fitMetaDprime(data)
  
    
  result = list(simulated = simulated %>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                # estimated = estimated%>% mutate(sim_n = qq, model = "old"),
                estimateda = estimateda%>% mutate(sim_n = qq, model = "action"),
                # additional = additional%>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                # loo = loo_comparison %>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                data = df%>% mutate(sim_n = qq),
                # div = div,
                diva = diva,
                mratio = mratio %>% mutate(sim_n = qq))
  
  return(result)
}
```
